description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective From 20.04.2020 to 26.04.2020
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (General) issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. This falls squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" category as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade and customs operations, published as a statutory instrument by a government authority.
